### Added

- (agent-platform) [The session view shows its egress refusals](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3163) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — When an agent's sandbox is refused an outbound host, the session shows `Egress refused: <host>:<port>` on the turn that met it, with the reason, the count and the origin to add to the agent's `Extra egress origins`. Needs the installation's metrics.
- (muster) [A Usage tab on the connector page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3159) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector's page has a Usage tab with `Tool calls`, `Error ratio`, `p95 latency` and `Tools used` over the last 30 days, a table per tool and, for a connector family, per instance. A tool's page shows the same figures for that tool.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.10.5...v3.11.0
